abstract: The successful development of the concept of linking cell-killing agents to tumour-specific antibodies will be largely determined by the extent to which the antibodies are preferentially localized in the malignant tissue. A xenograft of human choriocarcinoma (CC3) has been established in nude mice, and the relative distribution of affinity-purified specific antibodies to human chorionic gonadotrophin has been compared with that of nonspecific antibodies from the same species. Treatment of the nonspecific antibodies with ammonium thiocyanate appeared to be important to ensure that the distributions in normal nude mice were equivalent. Specificity indices, derived from the comparative distributions of isotope activity in the tumour and lung of labelled specific and nonspecific antibodies, ranged between 1.3 and 2.0.
abstract_ja: 細胞傷害薬を腫瘍特異的抗体に結合させる概念の発展は、抗体が悪性組織に優先的に局在するかどうかに大きく左右される。ヒト絨毛癌(CC3)の異種移植片をヌードマウスに確立し、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)に対する親和性精製特異的抗体の分布を、同種由来の非特異的抗体の分布と比較した。非特異的抗体をチオシアン酸アンモニウムで処理することは、正常ヌードマウスにおける分布を同等にするために重要と思われた。標識した特異的抗体と非特異的抗体の腫瘍と肺における同位体放射能の比較分布から導出した特異性指数は、1.3から2.0の範囲であった。
